title: World News in Brief: Ethiopians flee to Kenya amidst renewed conflict, new head of UN’s food programme, UN mission in Somalia concludes
content: Around 36,600 people have fled into northern Kenya following an uptick in fighting on the Ethiopian side of the border.

title: Sudan: Drone strikes killed at least 306 people in three weeks
content: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Friday strongly condemned an escalation in drone strikes across Sudan this month, which killed at least 306 people and injured hundreds more in the first three weeks of October alone.

title: Sudan conflict: Peace efforts resume to end ‘drone war’ fuelling humanitarian crisis
content: Talks to halt the fighting in Sudan and alleviate the humanitarian crisis there continued in Geneva on Wednesday, where nearly two dozen countries convened to discuss a pathway to a ceasefire and transition to peaceful governance that represents all Sudanese people.

title: General Assembly weighs US embargo against Cuba ahead of 34th vote
content: The General Assembly opened its annual debate on the US economic embargo against Cuba on Tuesday. On Wednesday, 28 October, Member States will vote for the 34th time on a resolution calling for it to end.

title: Security Council LIVE: Women and girls face greater dangers in war
content: From Gaza to Yemen, women and girls are facing ever greater dangers this year simply surviving in war zones. The Security Council meets Tuesday to debate the best way to improve security for women caught up in conflict.

title: As Sudan war spills into Central African Republic, UN warns against early peacekeeper exit
content: The UN warned on Tuesday against a premature withdrawal of its peacekeepers as the war in Sudan spills over into the Central African Republic (CAR).

title: UN condemns deadly wave of drone strikes in war-torn Sudan
content: Drone strikes killed and injured dozens across Sudan on Monday as the ongoing war continues to cause soaring displacement and hunger.

title: Haiti: Elections on hold as gangs adapt to security crackdown, Security Council hears
content: Armed groups in Haiti are adapting to intensified security operations, stepping up reprisals against civilians and extending their reach into rural areas, the UN warned the Security Council on Monday.

title: Guterres honours Indonesian troops who paid ‘ultimate sacrifice’
content: UN Secretary-General António Guterres paid tribute to Indonesian peacekeepers on Monday, laying a wreath in honour of four who recently lost their lives in Lebanon and offering a robust defence of UN peacekeeping in what he called “testing times for peace”.

title: Security Council LIVE: Sudan’s war spreads as drones and hunger take a deadly toll
content: As drone strikes kill civilians from El Obeid to Blue Nile and famine risk spreads across Darfur and Kordofan, the Security Council meets on Sudan – the world’s largest hunger and displacement crisis. Ambassadors are expected to press yet again for a ceasefire, safe aid access and an end to the weapons flows fuelling the brutal conflict.
